prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review the Mac archive’s path control before implementation. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. It displays only cryptic database IDs, clicking an ancestor deletes intervening folders, path items do not identify hierarchy and long paths truncate the current item while showing root in full. Files may be unavailable.

criteria.task_completion: Specify recognizable navigable ancestry/current-location behavior, careful compression and unavailable-location recovery; reject destructive navigation semantics and provide accessible item names.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the path-controls guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify recognizable navigable ancestry/current-location behavior, careful compression and unavailable-location recovery; reject destructive navigation semantics and provide accessible item names.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
